setup.title: OFFGRID setup
setup.h1: Set up OFFGRID on this phone
setup.lead: One time only, while you're on the hub's Wi-Fi. Then OFFGRID keeps working even when the hub and the internet are gone.
setup.not_ready: The hub isn't set up yet. On the laptop, run start_hub.bat, then reload this page.
setup.cert_missing: The hub isn't set up yet. Run start_hub.bat on the laptop.
setup.compare: Compare this code with the one on the hub laptop's screen. They must match:
setup.android: Open Settings → Security (or Security & privacy) → More security settings → Encryption & credentials → Install a certificate → CA certificate → Install anyway, and choose offgrid-ca.crt from Downloads.
setup.android8: On Android 8–9: Settings → Security & location → Encryption & credentials → Install from storage. Android may ask you to set a screen lock first; that's normal.
setup.iphone:
iPhone (Safari), two steps, both needed:
1. Settings → Profile Downloaded (or General → VPN & Device Management) → Install.
2. Settings → General → About → Certificate Trust Settings → turn on OFFGRID Hub.
setup.install:
Android (Chrome): menu (⋮) → Install app or Add to Home screen.
iPhone (Safari): Share button → Add to Home Screen → Add, then open OFFGRID from the new icon.
setup.keep_open: Keep it open until it says “Saved on this phone” (about 46 MB, a minute or two on hub Wi-Fi). After that OFFGRID works on this phone with no hub and no internet.
setup.cert_note: This certificate only works for private network addresses (like 192.168.x.x), so it can't be used to fake real websites. You can remove it any time in the same Settings screen.
